protected_invariants: HISTORICAL_GATE3_REQUEST_IMMUTABLE: the consumed HTTP 403 request, candidate, authorization, run id and request id are never modified, reused, or reclassified
NON_2XX_IS_CONSUMED_AND_TERMINAL: every non-2xx remains HTTP_FAILURE_AFTER_TRANSMISSION with no retry, authorization resurrection, RAW publication, or canonical transaction
FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS_ARE_PROSPECTIVE_ONLY: separate immutable repository-external evidence is bound to a future run/request and is not market RAW or a transaction

SECRET_SAFE_DIAGNOSTICS: allowlisted response headers and bounded payloads are redacted before persistence; credentials, authorization values, cookies, proxy credentials and preflight secrets never enter artifacts or logs
NO_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ACTIVITY: all validation uses fake/local transports and creates zero provider requests or provider DNS lookups
MERGE_AUTHORIZED_BY_OWNER_ON_EXACT_GREEN_HEAD: one squash merge is authorized only after CRITICAL dual review, exact-head CI, merge readiness, and post-merge Production Gate
forbidden_side_effects: contacting or resolving The Odds API, creating a final authorization, consuming another authorization, or making a second provider request
editing historical ledger entries or runtime evidence, reusing the spent candidate/authorization/run/request identifiers, or starting Stage D/scheduler/continuous operations
storing or logging provider credentials, proxy credentials, HMAC secrets, authorization values, or secret-bearing response data
modifying bookmaker registry semantics, PR #1914, reviewer architecture, proxy pools, training, prediction, backtest, or value betting
